details: Found 24 Oct after a merge: sync refused alix (its file carries the header of relay's old name, ~/principles) and exited 1, so arsenal, testenv, cartoons, clean, kartoteka, mind, sight, glyph and noisegate were not written either, silently, on every sync since the rename. Repeats on every sync (MEDIUM by the waste principle).
failing_case: A projects.toml with targets A (file has a foreign header), then B (relay's header, stale): `relay sync` exits 1 and B is unchanged.
pass_cases: Same setup: `relay sync` writes B, leaves A untouched, exits non-zero naming A and the --adopt command. A file with the old ~/principles header is rewritten without --adopt.
findings.summary: sync stops at one refused project; later ones go stale

scope: From queue item sync-stops-at-one-refused-project-later-ones-go: the fix is checked as finding Q1.
